body:
## Issue

The cookie-consent banner (`server/priv/static/consent.js`, `position:fixed; bottom:16px; z-index:2147483000`) renders **above** the toast stack (`client/src/components/toast.gleam` — `fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50`). While the banner is up (i.e. before the landlord makes a consent choice), **every toast fires and exists in the DOM but is visually hidden behind the banner** — including the refcheck "Attempt log copied" confirmation (OQ-5), which is exactly the moment a landlord needs the confirmation.

Observed in the 2026-08-14 bug-hunt re-run of `reference_checks/panel-export`: the toast is DOM-readable (`[role=alert]` present with the right text) but the screenshot shows the consent banner over the toast area. The same overlay appears in the panel-renders evidence. Any success/error toast during the consent window is invisible — a landlord clicking Export (or any confirm action) sees nothing happen.

## Context

- `consent.js:393` — banner: `position:fixed;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:2147483000` (deliberately extreme z-index, presumably to beat everything — including the toast layer)
- `client/src/components/toast.gleam` — toast container: `fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50`
- Same physical corner (bottom edge), same bottom anchoring → guaranteed overlap on short viewports

## Suggested fix (design decision)

1. Raise the toast container above the banner (`z-index` > 2147483000), and/or
2. Offset the toast stack upward while the banner is visible (banner is ~90px tall), and/or
3. Reconsider the banner's extreme z-index — it should overlay app content but never user confirmations.

## Repro

1. Log in with a fresh browser profile (no consent choice made).
2. Open an application with an in-flight reference call; expand the row; click **Export attempt log**.
3. The OQ-5 toast ("Attempt log copied…") fires — `document.querySelector('[role=alert]')` finds it — but it is not visible; the consent banner covers it.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Toasts (especially the OQ-5 export confirmation) are visible even while the consent banner is up
- [ ] No regression in consent-banner behaviour or layering elsewhere
title: Toasts hidden behind cookie-consent banner (z-index 2147483000 vs z-50) — export confirmation invisible until consent choice
